mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, avatar FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, title, content, cover_img, created_at, view_count, share_count, category, featured, published FROM mf_blog_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT id FROM mf_blog_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_blog_post (user_id, title, content, cover_img, category, featured, published) VALUES (#{entity.userId}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.content}, #{entity.coverImg}, #{entity.category}, #{entity.featured}, #{entity.published})
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_blog_post SET title = #{entity.title}, content = #{entity.content}, cover_img = #{entity.coverImg}, category = #{entity.category}, featured = #{entity.featured}, published = #{entity.published}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{entity.userId} AND id = #{entity.id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_blog_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
